## "legality"

**Data type:**  
Object

**Value:**  
Three fields inside the object; "copyright", "credit" and "license", each with null or a string as value.

**Description of metadata field:**  
This contains information about the legal status of an asset. Who does the copyrights belong to. Who should be credited. What type of license is this governed by.
